name: Melje Dam and Small HPP
zag_role: Third party quality control of the materials used in the upgrading of the Zlatoličje HPP, the Melje Dam and the Melje Small HPP
description: Third party quality control of the materials used in the upgrading of the Zlatoličje HPP, the Melje Dam and the Melje Small HPP.

specifications.label: Dam type
specifications.value: gated weir (jez) with overflow fields, stabilised with prestressed anchors

specifications.label: Gates
specifications.value: lower segment gates with upper flap gates

specifications.label: Monitoring
specifications.value: May 1994 first anchor-force check since 1965: 36/78 wires broken in right field, 45 in middle, none in left

specifications.label: Spillway
specifications.value: rating curves updated with 1:40 physical/OpenFOAM 3D models

specifications.label: Spillway bay width
specifications.quote: V VSAKEM PRETOČNEM POLJU ŠIRINE 17 m

specifications.label: Spillway bays, right group (horizontal foundation)
specifications.quote: Med gradnjo desnih treh pretočnih polj, ki so imela horizontalno temeljno ploskev

specifications.label: Spillway bays, left group (built later)
specifications.quote: V treh levih pretočnih poljih, ki so jih gradili pozneje

specifications.label: Foundation key under the left bays
specifications.quote: varnost proti zdrsu dosežena z 2 m globoko poglobitvijo

specifications.label: Prestressed anchors per bay
specifications.value: 6, each 20.5 m long, at 3.2 m spacing, inclined 15° and 25°
specifications.quote: po 6 sider, dolgih po 20,5 m, v razdalji po 3,2 m

specifications.label: Anchor design force
specifications.quote: natezna sila 6180 kN ali 1150 kN na posamezno sidro

specifications.label: Anchor prestressing force
specifications.quote: in natezno silo 1678 kN ob prednapenjanju.

specifications.label: Anchor head
specifications.value: 8 m long with 11 bulb widenings of 20 cm diameter
specifications.quote: Osem metrov dolge sidrne glave naših sider imajo 11 čebulastih razširitev

specifications.label: Anchor wires
specifications.value: 78 wires of 5 mm diameter per anchor
specifications.quote: v sidru od 78 žic s premerom 5 mm pretrganih 36

specifications.label: Impoundment level at Melje, design stage
specifications.quote: dvignila od sedanje povprečne kote 246 m na 253 m

specifications.label: Water level rise at Melje, design stage
specifications.quote: Umetni dvig gladine bo v Melju 7 do 8 m

source_differences: Record 'facts' Position still says 'the municipality centre' although the coordinate was corrected to the weir.

Gates: he_zlatolicje record says six spillway gates, Breznik (1994) describes three overflow fields (left, middle, right) and Hidroinštitut describes lower segment gates with upper flap gates, i.e. possibly 3 fields x 2 gates. Count of six not verified.
